name: Principiante
description: Usuario básico: frases cotidianas, presentaciones, información personal simple.

examples.instruction: Complete with am, is or are.
examples.question: My sister ___ a nurse.

commonErrors.feedback: Con he/she/it o un sustantivo singular se usa 'is'.

examples.instruction: Complete with am, is or are.
examples.question: We ___ from Argentina.

commonErrors.feedback: Con we/you/they se usa 'are'.
'My parents' es plural (they): se usa 'aren't'.

skills.name: Preguntas
objectives: invertir sujeto y verbo to be

commonErrors.feedback: En las preguntas, 'is' va antes del sujeto.

examples.instruction: Choose the correct word to start the question.
examples.question: ___ your brother a doctor?

examples.instruction: Complete with the correct form of the verb in brackets.
examples.question: Tom ___ (watch) TV every evening.

commonErrors.feedback: Con he/she/it, los verbos terminados en -ch agregan -es.
Los verbos terminados en -ch llevan -es, no -s.

examples.instruction: Choose the correct form of the verb.
examples.question: My dad ___ TV every night.

commonErrors.feedback: Después de 'doesn't' va el verbo en forma base.
Con he/she/it (Anna) se usa 'doesn't'.

examples.instruction: Complete the question with do or does.
examples.question: ___ she work on Saturdays?

commonErrors.feedback: Con he/she/it se usa 'does'.

examples.question: Your parents live in Rosario.
acceptedAnswers: Do your parents live in Rosario?

commonErrors.answer: Does your parents live in Rosario?
commonErrors.feedback: 'Your parents' es plural: se usa 'do'.

examples.instruction: Complete with the present continuous of the verb in brackets.
examples.question: Look! The children ___ (run) in the park.

commonErrors.feedback: Se duplica la consonante final: run → running.
Falta am/is/are antes del verbo con -ing.

examples.instruction: Complete with the present continuous of the verb in brackets.
examples.question: They ___ (play) football in the park now.

commonErrors.feedback: Falta el verbo 'to be': 'are playing'.

examples.question: My grandmother ___ use a computer. She never learned.

commonErrors.feedback: Los peces no pueden caminar: 'can't'.

examples.instruction: Complete with there is or there are.
examples.question: ___ two banks near my house.

commonErrors.feedback: 'Two banks' es plural: se usa 'there are'.

examples.question: There ___ two bedrooms in my flat.

commonErrors.feedback: 'Engineer' empieza con sonido vocal: se usa 'an'.

skills.name: my / your / his / her / our / their
objectives: elegir el posesivo según el poseedor

examples.question: Anna and Mark live with ___ parents.

commonErrors.feedback: El poseedor es María (she): 'her'.

examples.instruction: Complete with in, on or at.
examples.question: The meeting is ___ Monday.

commonErrors.feedback: Con los días de la semana se usa 'on'.

examples.question: ___ do you live? — In Buenos Aires.

examples.instruction: Complete with where, when or who.
examples.question: ___ do you live? — In Córdoba.

skills.name: Pronombres personales (sujeto)
objectives: reemplazar un sustantivo por I, you, he, she, it, we, they

examples.question: Maria is my friend. ___ is from Chile.
Tom and I are brothers. ___ live in Salta.

commonErrors.feedback: 'Tom and I' te incluye a vos: 'We'.
Después de -x se agrega -es: 'boxes'.

skills.name: Have got
objectives: have got / has got para posesión
negativo y preguntas con have got

examples.instruction: Complete with have got or has got.
examples.question: My sister ___ a new phone.

commonErrors.feedback: Con he/she/it (my sister) se usa 'has got'.

examples.question: They have got a car.
acceptedAnswers: They have not got a car.

skills.name: Imperativos
objectives: dar instrucciones con el verbo base

examples.instruction: Complete the instruction with the verb in brackets.
examples.question: ___ (open) your books at page ten.
Look at ___ birds in the sky over there!
I love ___ shoes! They are really comfortable.

commonErrors.feedback: 'shoes' es plural: 'these'.

skills.name: in / on / under / next to / behind
objectives: ubicar objetos con preposiciones de lugar básicas

examples.question: The keys are ___ my bag. I can't see them because the bag is closed.

examples.instruction: Complete with in, on or under.
examples.question: The picture is ___ the wall.

skills.name: and / but / or / because
objectives: unir ideas con and, but, or, because

examples.question: I like tea, ___ I don't like coffee.

examples.instruction: Complete with and, but, or or because.
examples.question: I'm tired ___ I worked all day.

skills.name: Rutinas
objectives: verbos y expresiones de rutina diaria

examples.question: I ___ up at 7 o'clock every day.
I ___ up at seven o'clock every morning.

skills.name: Familia
objectives: nombres de miembros de la familia

commonErrors.feedback: 'Aunt' es tía. El hermano de tu mamá es tu 'uncle'.

skills.name: Trabajos
objectives: profesiones comunes y lugares de trabajo

examples.question: A ___ works in a hospital and helps doctors.
A ___ works in a school and teaches children.
A: Nice to meet you. B: ___
A: How ___ you? B: I'm fine, thanks.

skills.name: Números
objectives: números del 1 al 100 escritos y hablados

commonErrors.feedback: 'fifty' es 50; 15 es 'fifteen'.

examples.question: How do you write 40 in words?

skills.name: Días, meses y fechas
objectives: días de la semana y meses del año

examples.question: The sky is ___ on a sunny day.
It's very cold. Put on your ___.

skills.name: La casa
objectives: ambientes y muebles de la casa

examples.question: I sleep in my ___ every night.

skills.name: Números, precios y horas
objectives: entender números, precios y horas en frases cortas

examples.instruction: Listen and complete with the time.
examples.question: The train to London leaves at ___.
examples.stimulus: Good morning. The next train to London leaves at half past eight.

commonErrors.feedback: Escuchá de nuevo: dice 'half past eight' (8:30).

examples.instruction: Listen and choose the correct answer.
examples.question: How much is the coffee?
examples.stimulus: The coffee is three dollars and the cake is five dollars.

skills.name: Datos personales
objectives: entender nombre, edad, país y deletreo en una presentación

examples.instruction: Listen and complete with a number.
examples.question: Laura is ___ years old.
examples.stimulus: Hi, I'm Laura. I'm twenty-six years old and I'm from Canada.

examples.instruction: Listen and choose the correct answer.
examples.question: Where is Laura from?
examples.stimulus: Hi, I'm Laura. I'm twenty-six years old and I'm from Canada.

skills.name: Diálogos cortos
objectives: entender la idea principal de un diálogo cotidiano breve (saludar, comprar, pedir comida)

examples.instruction: Listen to the conversation and choose the correct answer.
examples.question: What does the customer order?
examples.stimulus: Can I have a cheese sandwich and an orange juice, please? Sure. Anything else? No, thank you.
options: A cheese sandwich and an orange juice
A cheese sandwich and a coffee
A ham sandwich and an orange juice
acceptedAnswers: A cheese sandwich and an orange juice

examples.instruction: Listen to the conversation and choose the correct answer.
examples.question: Where are they going on Saturday?
examples.stimulus: Are you free on Saturday? Yes, why? Let's go to the cinema. Great idea!

skills.name: Instrucciones simples
objectives: entender instrucciones simples de clase o de la vida diaria

examples.question: Please ___ the window.
examples.stimulus: Please close the window. It's cold in here.

commonErrors.feedback: Dice 'close' (cerrar): hace frío.

examples.instruction: Listen and choose the correct answer.
examples.question: Which page do the students open?
examples.stimulus: Open your books at page twelve and read the text.

skills.name: Comprensión de textos breves
objectives: identificar información concreta en un texto corto

examples.instruction: Read the text and answer the question.
examples.passage: Hi, I'm Lucía. I'm 28 and I live in Córdoba. I work in a small café. I start work at 8 a.m. and finish at 4 p.m. After work, I go to the gym.
examples.question: What does Lucía do after work?

examples.instruction: Read the text and answer the question.
examples.passage: Tom lives in a small house near the sea. He works in a restaurant in the town centre. Every morning he walks to work because it is only ten minutes from his house. In the evening he plays the guitar with his friends.
examples.question: How does Tom go to work?

skills.name: Oraciones simples sobre uno mismo
objectives: usar presente simple y to be correctamente

examples.question: Describe your family: who are they and what do they do?

skills.name: Contar tu rutina
objectives: usar presente simple con expresiones de frecuencia y hora

examples.question: What do you usually do on Saturdays?
What do you do after work or school?

skills.name: Mensajes cortos
objectives: escribir un mensaje breve a un amigo o familiar
invitar, avisar o pedir algo con oraciones simples

examples.question: Write a message to a friend. Invite them to the cinema on Saturday.
Write a note to your family. You are late for dinner: say why and when you arrive.

skills.name: Describir personas y lugares
objectives: describir a una persona o un lugar con 2-3 oraciones
usar to be, have got y there is/are con adjetivos

examples.question: Describe your best friend: what does he or she look like?
Describe your house or flat: how many rooms are there?

skills.name: Armar oraciones
objectives: ordenar palabras para formar una oración correcta
escribir oraciones y preguntas completas con mayúscula y punto

examples.instruction: Put the words in order to make a sentence.
examples.question: work / I / in / an office

commonErrors.feedback: En inglés el verbo va después del sujeto: sujeto + verbo + resto.

examples.instruction: Put the words in order to make a question.
examples.question: you / do / like / pizza

commonErrors.feedback: Las preguntas en presente simple llevan 'do' al principio.

examples.instruction: Put the words in order to make a sentence.
examples.question: is / from / she / Spain
